proposition: Ibn Turka was born in 770/1369; the year is derived from his own statement, in the Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I completed on 8 Rajab 829/16 May 1426, that he was 59 lunar years old, since no source gives the date directly.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I (829/1426), addressed to Shāhrukh
mediation.note: his age as he stated it to Shāhrukh
